programme.title: The Jamie Foxx Show
programme.sub-title: Serve No Wine Before I Get Mine
programme.desc: Jamie (Jamie Foxx) is swindled by a music producer (Ed Lover) who steals the love song he wrote for Fancy (Garcelle Beauvais).

programme.title: The Jamie Foxx Show
programme.desc: Jamie and Fancy's (Jamie Foxx, Garcelle Beauvais) fledgling friendship founders because they can't stay out of the bedroom.

programme.title: The Wayans Bros.
programme.desc: Shawn's (Shawn Wayans) landlady (Adrienne Barbeau) makes a pass at him and Shawn must decide how to deal with the unwanted attention.

programme.title: The Wayans Bros.
programme.desc: Marlon (Marlon Wayans) decides acting is in his future and wants to get out of the newsstand business. Los Angeles Clippers' Brent Barry guest stars.

programme.title: The Wayans Bros.
programme.desc: After breaking his leg in a fall at the newsstand, Marlon (Marlon Wayans) decides to sue Shawn (Shawn Wayans) for his injuries.

programme.title: The Wayans Bros.
programme.desc: Shawn and Marlon let Grandma live with them, then find she's overbearing.

programme.title: The Wayans Bros.
programme.desc: It's girl troubles for Shawn (Shawn Wayans) when his girlfriend decides Marlon (Marlon Wayans) is more her type.

programme.title: The Wayans Bros.
programme.desc: Shawn sees a new side of himself as he discovers his street-self.

programme.title: America's Funniest Home Videos
programme.desc: Birthday blunders, including a little girl who wishes her birthday occurred every year; dogs with human hands; a little boy with bubbles coming out of his mouth denies taking a taste of shampoo.

programme.title: America's Funniest Home Videos
programme.sub-title: The Scratchin' Post, Basketball, and $100,000 Competition
programme.desc: Nine finalists compete for the $100,000 prize; basketball blunders; trick shots; curious cats.

programme.title: Help! I'm in a Secret Relationship!
programme.desc: Sydney and Dominic have been dating for three years; it was perfect in the beginning, but everything changed a year ago and Sydney is no longer allowed around Dominic's family or friends, and she's blocked on social media; she wants to know why.

programme.title: Help! I'm in a Secret Relationship!
programme.desc: Tangy and Jenny built a beautiful life together with Jenny's five children; Tangy wants to propose and become a legal guardian, but she can't until she figures out why Jenny is hiding her from everyone else in her life.

programme.title: Help! I'm in a Secret Relationship!
programme.desc: Jake believes Sarah is special from their first meeting; the relationship moves quickly, and he can't imagine life with anyone else; but before he takes the next step, he needs to find out why Sarah's hiding him.

programme.title: Help! I'm in a Secret Relationship!
programme.desc: DeeDee's been hiding Tirelle for the entirety of their five-year relationship, and he's broken up with her in the past for not letting him meet her friends and family; they're now back together, but DeeDee's still hiding Tirelle.

programme.title: Help! I'm in a Secret Relationship!
programme.desc: Rolando leaves everything behind for love, moving to Seattle to build a life with Joshua; two-and-a-half years in, Joshua is still hiding Rolando from his family and his past in California; Rolando wants answers.

programme.title: Help! I'm in a Secret Relationship!
programme.desc: Matt and Danny went from long distance to no distance in a matter of weeks; they're only ten months into their relationship, but Matt is ready to move in with Danny, but there's a problem, he's being hidden.

programme.title: Catfish: The TV Show
programme.desc: Dianela flees her home in Venezuela to start a new life with a man she's been in a relationship with for years but still has never met.

programme.title: Catfish: The TV Show
programme.desc: A mystery email leads Nev and Laura to help Derek track down his online love, Annabelle; after digging, they uncover a sexy Snapchat scandal, betrayal, and a conclusion that hits closer to home than Derek expected.

programme.title: Catfish: The TV Show
programme.desc: Frustrated by several failed attempts to video chat with Shai, Telizza turns to Nev and Max to uncover the truth.

programme.title: Catfish: The TV Show
programme.desc: Kiaira and Cortney had a baby, but the two have never met; Nev and Max jump in to bring the family together, but they worry this could be a serious manipulation.

programme.title: Catfish: The TV Show
programme.desc: Cherie enlists the help of Nev and Justin to find out more about the man she sent sexy pictures to.

programme.title: Catfish: The TV Show
programme.desc: Nev and co-host Tallulah Willis help Chelsea, a young woman who is in love with a reality TV star; digging for the truth only reveals Chelsea has her own secrets.

programme.title: Catfish: The TV Show
programme.desc: Model Dallas has had his sights set on sexy Safari ever since she slid into his DMs, but despite flirty promises, she won't meet; Nev and co-host Tallulah Willis take Dallas on a wild ride as they hunt for Safari.
